items.summary: Supported day-to-day IT operations across the company.
highlights: Administered the company-wide Microsoft 365 tenant — role-based access control, user provisioning, access and licensing
Handled first-line incident response for hardware, software and network faults to minimise downtime
Maintained IT asset inventory and device lifecycle records — assignments, accessories and employee handovers
Worked alongside the engineering team on cloud and deployment operations, following release, automation and infrastructure practices in a live environment

items.summary: Graduation project: a Hybrid Intrusion Detection System combining machine learning with Snort 3 signatures.
